title: Book One · Chapter 160: The Card Dad Keeps
story:
Dad sees the final stool card on Thursday. Ronan brings it to him after work. The carrying plan is underneath the card. He has changed the letters so visitors can read them easily.

Dad reads every line. He checks the small drawing of the repaired leg. “Where will you put the real stool?” he asks. Is it still beside the chair, as they agreed?

“Yes. Miss Wu has the plan.”

“And the old-home picture?”

“In the boards here. It stays home.”

Ronan goes to the shelf and shows him. The private shop card is behind the old picture. He has kept both of them. He wrote them before his talk with Dad. They show his old ideas. He wants to keep them for himself.

Dad looks at the cover. He leaves it closed.

“Thank you.”

Ronan puts the boards back. “You can say no to other things too.”

“So can you.”

They sit at the table with the final card between them. Dad changes nothing this time. He writes a small yes on the back. Then he adds the date beside it. Ronan asked him to write it. Now Miss Wu can see Dad's permission herself. Now Miss Wu can read YES on the card herself.

Ronan looks at Dad's writing on the back. It says yes to the stool and these words. It does not say yes to the old story. Ronan keeps that private card at home.

Mum comes in carrying the shirts she has finished. She will return them tomorrow. One collar still needs pressing. Dad clears a place for her before she asks.

“That stool has more papers than a new house,” she says.

“We have moved it all over the plan. The real stool is still by our door,” Dad says.

Ronan laughs. He makes a second copy for his own book. The display card might get misplaced. He wants a copy he can find easily. Dad watches him, then reaches inside the blue tool box.

He takes out the invitation with the little tree. The lid pressed a faint line into the paper. It is otherwise clean.

“I showed Mr Sun the time again,” he says. “The work is still booked. I will try to come.”

Ronan wants Dad to leave work early for him. But customers have paid to have their things repaired. They will come to collect them that afternoon. Dad must finish the work. He does want to come to school. But he must finish the work first.

“I will be by the map at first,” he says. “If you come later, someone can find me.”

Dad nods. He puts the invitation in his shirt pocket. It is away from the tools there.

After supper they carry the stool into the yard for one more check. Dad sits, then stands again. He turns the stool to see the leg in better light. Nothing moves. He rubs a rough spot with a cloth. It is under the seat. Then he gives the stool back to Mum.

She sits down to finish the collar. Ronan reads the card once more in a quiet voice. Dad listens until Ronan finishes the last line. Then he goes to wash the bowls. Mum sits on the repaired stool to work. It will go to school on Saturday. Tonight she can still use it at home.

---

重点表达：permission＝许可；misplaced＝放错位置；collar＝衣领。

情节提示：pressing＝熨平；collar＝衣领；faint＝淡淡的。

理解：1. Dad 在卡片背面留下了什么？2. 他的工作和到场安排有没有发生确定改变？
